title: City directory spellings of the Matassa name
summary: The interviewer reads directory listings for Vincent Matassa and variant spellings; Matassa explains the name means skein.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: That there was more activity in that area. I went to start going through some of the city directories, and there's some matasses that I picked up in the...
Mm-hmm.
Going through the directories. And I... The first one I see in 1908 is a... Well, this may be a relative, but I don't know. It's a Vincenzo. Vincenzo.
Vincenzo. Vincenzo.
And it says Matasso. M-A-T-A-S-S-O.
That's because they mispronounced... It misspelled his name. They just misspelled it? Sure. That was my father's uncle, the one that he came to work...
That was his... Yeah.
Vincent Matassa, yeah.
Okay. That was the uncle. Mm-hmm. And interestingly enough, he's living at 527 Hospital Street, which became 527 Governor Nichols.
Right.
Which... Yeah. Which he would own.
Yeah.
At some point in time. In 1911, there's a Vincent Matassa, and he's working for the Lanassa brothers. And they have... They're at 1116 Decatur Street.
I don't know what that is. But, yeah, that's him. Yeah, that's him. That's still him. Yeah.
That's... But, and he's living... He's living on 1210 Charters.
Mm-hmm. Yeah, because Charters and Barracks is where the uncle's store was. So, it may be that...
In 1912, yeah, there's a Vincent... But they're spelling it Matasco. M-A-T-A-S-S-C-O.
Oh, well. Too bad.
So, it's always Matassa.
Yeah, sure. It's always been M-A-T-A-S-S-A. Okay.
Because I'm seeing all these different spellings in it.
Mm-hmm. For whatever it's worth, Matassa is the Italian word for skein, S-K-E-I-N. That's what it's called. You know, the loop of loose wool.
Okay.
Okay.
So, there's actual meaning there.
Yeah. Yeah. Well, most family names are. You know, Smith, obviously, being the most obvious one. And Baker, and so forth.
